take: Coursera embeds video playback and study tools inside the desktop lesson shell.
observed: The course sequence remains at left while the player exposes autoplay, quality, speed, subtitles, and fullscreen; Transcript, Notes, and Downloads sit below.
limits: Shows video playback, not an opened attachment or inline document preview.

take: Coursera keeps mobile video and supporting lesson tabs in one sequential view.
observed: Video remains above Transcript, Notes, Summary, and Attachments; Previous and Next controls stay visible. Notes is selected and displays timestamped video snippets.
limits: The Attachments tab is visible but unopened, so attachment preview behavior is unknown.

take: Kajabi composes lesson media, outline, completion, copy, and a downloadable file on one learner page.
observed: Large visual media appears beside a User Testing lesson outline; a PDF_File.pdf link sits in a Downloads card alongside the lesson body.
limits: No playback controls or opened PDF are visible, so inline video playback and file preview cannot be confirmed.

take: Skillshare keeps video playback and lesson download status inline, but sends learners to another course tab for files.
observed: The mobile player shows playback controls, a lesson list, and Downloading status; text says course files and resources are in the Projects tab.
limits: The destination tab and any file preview are not shown.

take: Dropbox Dash uses progressive disclosure from item list to quick look to a contextual side-pane preview.
observed: The flow begins in a Stack, reveals a floating image quick look, then opens a larger right-side preview while the Stack remains visible; Open can launch the source.
limits: Generic file-workspace analogue, not a course or learner experience; only an image is demonstrated.

take: Squarespace configures lesson video in an instructor modal; it does not demonstrate preview or playback.
observed: Edit lesson has General, Video, and Status sections; Video shows a Show lesson video toggle, empty Add a Video area, storage allowance, and Save/Cancel.
limits: Authoring state only. Best fit is Q1 for adding media, with Q5 as a secondary visibility reference.
